summary: Add person-and-agent scoped accepted-message history candidate seeks

replay.detail: History candidates read accepted source claims directly; no new claim fold or prompt journal is introduced.

schema.detail: Add two rebuildable local SQLite expression indexes over accepted message headers. No replicated schema, wire schema or storage-version transition.

rules.detail: No new admission, sensitivity, retention or deletion rule; current repaired-claim exclusions and caller source authorization apply.

compatibility.detail: No client endpoint or keyboard behavior changes. Older builds ignore the extra source indexes.

downtime.detail: The first upgraded store open builds the indexes over existing claims; startup cost has not been measured on a production-sized store.

recovery.detail: Accepted messages remain authoritative; indexes are derived and contain no additional prompt bodies.
